newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan rate levels must be raised -- opposition head.
newsitem.headline: Japan rate levels must be raised -- opposition head.

text.p: Ichiro Ozawa, head of Japan's main opposition party Shinshinto, said on Monday that the country's interest rate levels must be corrected.
He said during a debate of heads of political parties ahead of general elections that unfavourable effects of low interest rates were spreading.
"Interest rate levels could be naturally adjusted as the the economy is activated. Interest rate levels must be corrected," he said.
He had been asked if low rates were affecting lives of people dependent on interest rate income.
The Bank of Japan's official discount rate has been at a record low of 0.5 percent since September 1995.
A general election is scheduled to take place in Japan on October 20.
